description: Finite interpretations for the two sense forks: an omission model for every premise of PRIOR-SENSE-FORK-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR and CAUSE-SENSE-FORK-NO-SELF-EFFICIENT-CAUSE (in each the route reads the term in the branch the omitted premise closes), a nonvacuity witness per fork, and per term a model of coverage without exclusivity in which two uses differ. Satisfiability and omission only; no model describes reality.
